title: From paper-based procedures to traceable digital processes with COBRA BPM
excerpt: Automating pre-contract workflows cuts turnaround times, eliminates errors and records who did what at every stage.
content:
Automating pre-contract workflows cuts turnaround times, eliminates errors and records who did what at every stage.

The invisible process

Before a contract exists, there are dozens of steps: preliminary studies, reviews, approvals, signatures. That journey is rarely measured. Nobody knows exactly where the process stalls, only that it does.

What COBRA BPM enables

  • Model approval workflows and procedures tailored to the entity.
  • Automate repetitive tasks to reduce turnaround times and errors.
  • Record who did what, and when, at every stage.
  • Measure bottlenecks with real performance indicators.

Digitizing a process isn't scanning paper; it's making the process leave a measurable trail.

Where to start

We recommend starting with a single high-volume workflow (usually the pre-contract process), measuring it for a quarter and expanding based on that evidence. Full automation from day one usually fails due to organizational resistance.
